svg.text: ESP32 WiFi Sensor Node — Wiring Diagram
Indoor installation (shelter) with outdoor sensors — Wi-Fi to Pi 3B+ hub

g.text: DevKIT → Qwiic adapter → 100mm cable → LTC4311 → splice → Cat5 3–4 m → splice → BME280 → LTR390
ADC ← Vane | GPIO (INT) ← Rain | GPIO (INT) ← Anemo | SDA/SCL → Qwiic → LTC4311 → Cat5 → BME280 → LTR390 | Wi-Fi → Pi 3B+
